lenses.failure_description: The task never establishes what counts as the greeting output boundary, so teams cannot tell whether the farewell belongs in the same message, a separate line, or a different channel entirely.
lenses.observable_signal: Different readers describe the expected output shape differently or sketch incompatible examples without noticing the conflict.
lenses.why_material: If the output boundary is unclear, the resulting handoff cannot be implemented consistently.
lenses.minimal_test_shape: Ask two implementers to write the exact expected output for the same simple input and compare whether the farewell placement matches.

lenses.failure_description: The meaning of optional is left unstated, so it is unclear who or what decides when the farewell line appears.
lenses.observable_signal: Follow-up questions cluster around whether the line is controlled by user input, configuration, context, or default behavior.
lenses.why_material: An implementable handoff must state the trigger for conditional behavior; otherwise multiple valid but incompatible implementations emerge.
lenses.minimal_test_shape: Present one greeting scenario and ask when the farewell should appear; failure is visible if answers depend on unstated assumptions.

lenses.failure_description: The handoff captures that a farewell line exists but not what qualifies as that line, leaving wording, formatting, punctuation, and variability unconstrained.
lenses.observable_signal: Reviewers agree on the feature headline but produce different acceptance examples for the actual farewell text.
lenses.why_material: Without a concrete content contract, downstream implementation and verification cannot distinguish intended behavior from arbitrary output.
lenses.minimal_test_shape: Request three canonical output examples and check whether the farewell text and formatting remain stable across them.

lenses.failure_description: Validation covers only the case where the farewell appears and misses cases where greeting output should remain unchanged.
lenses.observable_signal: Test examples or review notes mention added farewell behavior but provide no explicit unchanged-output scenario.
lenses.why_material: Conditional output changes are incomplete without proving both activation and non-activation behavior.
lenses.minimal_test_shape: Check whether the requirement set includes at least one example with the farewell present and one with it absent for otherwise similar greeting flows.
